text:
Priya S.: Heads-up — SI partner asked for a lightweight security snapshot for the marketplace listing. They want: SOC2 Type II report, pen-test executive summary, completed vendor questionnaire, and a small set of redacted artifacts we can presign. Deadline is EOW for their legal review.

Ben C.: I have the SOC2 (2025-10) PDF and the pentest high-level summary from 2026-01. Where should I drop them?

Priya S.: Put the originals in the internal bucket: s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/inbound/partner-a/ — we'll create a redacted bundle for external sharing.

Kevin L. (sec): Quick rules for redaction: remove IPs and internal hostnames, redact any customer-specific data, strip out raw vuln details (CVSS > 7 should be summarized as "addressed" with mitigation date). We'll keep a private copy for auditors.

Olivia M.: Partner prefers a 1-page executive summary + the SOC2 attestation PDF + a 2-page pentest executive summary. They asked for presigned links valid 7 days. Can we do that?

Ben C.: Yes. I'll upload SOC2 -> /inbound/partner-a/soc2-2025Q4.pdf and pentest-summary -> /inbound/partner-a/pen-summary-202601.pdf. Then create a redacted bundle under /outbound/partner-a/.

Kevin L. (sec): For the redacted bundle, owners: Ben (SOC + pentest), Priya (questionnaire + exec summary), Security will review redactions (that's me). Add a README that lists what was redacted and why (non-sensitive language).

Priya S.: I'll own the vendor questionnaire answers. Ben, can you share the list of docs you need redacted by Wed noon?

Ben C.: Yes. ETA Wed 11:30. Command I'll run to presign once bundle is ready: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/partner-a/redacted-bundle.zip --expires-in 604800` (7 days = 604800s).

Kevin L. (sec): Also include checksum file (SHA256) and a short integrity note: how long the presigned link will last and who generated it. No direct credentials in any file.

Olivia M.: I'll notify the SI that links will be presigned and TTL=7 days. They asked if we can extend to 14 days if legal needs more time — we can, but prefer 7.

Priya S.: Action list: 1) Ben upload originals (inbound) — Ben, done Wed 11:30? 2) Ben produce redacted bundle -> outbound — Ben by Thu 10:00. 3) Security review redactions -> Kevin by Thu 16:00. 4) Priya complete questionnaire + exec summary -> Thu 18:00. 5) Generate presigned links -> Ben after Kevin signoff.

remind-bot: Reminder set for @channel: "Marketplace security bundle due Thu" at 2026-03-26 09:00.

Ben C.: Uploaded originals and started redaction pass. Dropped a quick note in the S3 folder: `redaction_notes.md`.

Kevin L. (sec): Reviewed draft redactions — two spots to re-redact (internal service IDs). Ben, pushed comments to the `redaction_notes.md`.

Ben C.: Fixed those, created `redacted-bundle-v1.zip` in /outbound/partner-a/ and `sha256.txt`. Ready for final signoff.

Priya S.: Questionnaire done and exec summary attached in outbound. Kevin, can you confirm signoff?

Kevin L. (sec): Signoff granted. Docs look good. Generating presigned link now.

Ben C.: Presigned link created: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-marketplace-artifacts/outbound/partner-a/redacted-bundle-v1.zip?X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Expires=604800

Olivia M.: Sharing this with SI now. Thanks everyone — smooth and fast :thumbsup:.

Priya S.: Closing the loop: logged artifact exchange in the marketplace tracker (row 42), set retention for outbound to 90 days, internal copies kept in archival bucket with restricted access. If partner asks for longer TTL, escalate to legal.

Ben C.: ACK.

Kevin L. (sec): +1. Good template for future listings — we should capture this as a checklist in the partnerships playbook.

Olivia M.: Will add a short how-to in the partner onboarding doc.

Priya S.: Thanks all — thread closed unless any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
